cards.answer: Darius is a fighter and tank who builds up a physical-damage bleed. He pulls enemies toward him and can finish enemy champions with true damage. Focus on learning his attack-damage tools.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance to limit his bleed stacks and avoid being pulled into close combat.

cards.answer: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times. Applying five stacks to an enemy champion or killing a champion with Noxian Guillotine temporarily grants Darius bonus attack damage. While empowered, his eligible bleed applications instantly apply five stacks.
cards.counterplay: Disengage before he builds five stacks on you. Avoid letting him spread a full bleed while empowered.

citations.quote: Darius' attacks and damaging abilities cause enemies to bleed for physical damage over 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
Darius' attacks and abilities have to deal damage to apply Hemorrhage.

facts.claim: Eligible damaging attacks and abilities apply a physical-damage bleed that stacks up to five times.

citations.quote: When Darius kills a champion with Noxian Guillotine, or applies 5 stacks on an enemy champion, he becomes empowered with Noxian Might for 5 seconds.
Noxian Might: Darius gains 30 – 230 (based on level) bonus attack damage and instantly applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks through his usual means.

facts.claim: Applying five stacks to an enemy champion or killing a champion with Noxian Guillotine temporarily grants Darius bonus attack damage.

citations.quote: Noxian Might: Darius gains 30 – 230 (based on level) bonus attack damage and instantly applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks through his usual means.

facts.claim: While empowered, his eligible bleed applications instantly apply five stacks.

passive_visual.description: Markers gather around the bleeding target, and a large emblem appears as Darius becomes empowered.

cards.priority_reason: Full stacks empower Darius and let him rapidly spread a stronger bleed.
uncertainties: The visual cue is a tentative proposal from the supplied official-clip frames, not current-client or skin-specific verification; riot:P identifies the associated passive demonstration.
Eligible applications exclude Q handle hits, structures, wards and invulnerable targets. Ordinary shields permit application; spell shields prevent ability-based application.
R kills involving clones, resurrection protection or zombie states have separate empowerment exceptions.

cards.answer: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage. The outer blade deals more damage and can apply Hemorrhage; the inner handle deals reduced damage and neither applies nor refreshes it. Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of eligible targets hit.
cards.counterplay: Move outside the swing or into the inner handle area to avoid the blade's stronger hit and deny its healing from you.

Darius winds up and swings his axe in a wide circle.

facts.claim: After a windup, Darius swings his axe around himself, dealing physical damage.

citations.quote: Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle.
When Darius hits a champion with the blade, he applies a Hemorrhage stack and heals based on his missing health, multiplied by the number of champions hit up to 3.
Enemies hit by the inner radius do not refresh the duration of or gain a stack of Hemorrhage.

facts.claim: The outer blade deals more damage and can apply Hemorrhage; the inner handle deals reduced damage and neither applies nor refreshes it.

Against champions and large monsters hit, Darius heals for 17% – 51% (based on number of targets hit by the outer radius) of his missing health.

facts.claim: Blade hits on enemy champions and large monsters heal him based on his missing health and the number of eligible targets hit.

cards.priority_reason: Blade positioning determines his stronger damage, bleed application and healing.
uncertainties: The Wiki's brief summary mentions champions for healing, while its detailed description and Riot also include large monsters.

cards.answer: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target. Crippling Strike also resets his basic attack timer.
cards.counterplay: Keep out of basic-attack reach to avoid the empowered hit and its slow.

citations.quote: Active: Darius' next basic attack within a few seconds deals increased physical damage and slows the target.
Darius's next attack strikes an enemy's crucial artery. As they bleed out, their Move Speed is slowed.

facts.claim: Darius empowers his next basic attack to deal increased physical damage and slow its target.

citations.quote: Crippling Strike resets Darius' basic attack timer.

facts.claim: Crippling Strike also resets his basic attack timer.

cards.priority_reason: The slow helps him maintain contact, and the attack reset supports faster attack sequences.
uncertainties: The Wiki reports an unexpected spell-shield interaction that blocks the entire empowered attack; this advanced interaction is omitted from the beginner explanation.
Kills reduce the cooldown and refund mana, except for jungle plants; they do not fully reset the cooldown.

cards.answer: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage. On activation, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Stay outside the cone or move sideways to avoid being pulled into his attack range.

citations.quote: Darius hones his axe, passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor.

facts.claim: Darius passively gains percentage armor penetration for his physical damage.

citations.quote: Active: Darius sweeps in a cone in the target direction, slowing and pulling enemies hit towards him.
When activated, Darius sweeps up his enemies with his axe's hook and pulls them to him.

facts.claim: On activation, he sweeps a cone in front of him, pulling enemies hit toward him and slowing them.

cards.priority_reason: The pull forces enemies into close combat and the slow hinders escape.
uncertainties: The Wiki marks rebound-location calculation and the absence of a simultaneous stun, including the brittle interaction, as pending testing. These are not treated as confirmed.

cards.answer: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leaping strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target. A qualifying kill lets him use it again through a temporary recast window. At maximum rank, a qualifying kill fully resets its cooldown instead.
cards.counterplay: Avoid staying near him at low health, especially with several bleed stacks. Keep your distance after he secures a kill with his ultimate.

citations.quote: Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target.
dealing true damage based on the target's current Hemorrhage stacks.

facts.claim: Darius targets an enemy champion with a leaping strike that deals true damage, increased by each Hemorrhage stack already on the target.

citations.quote: If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.
He can also recast the ability within 20 seconds at no cost, which refreshes on further successful executions.

facts.claim: A qualifying kill lets him use it again through a temporary recast window.

citations.quote: At max rank, Noxian Guillotine permanently resets its cooldown if the target dies very briefly afterwards.

facts.claim: At maximum rank, a qualifying kill fully resets its cooldown instead.

cards.priority_reason: Stack-enhanced true damage and kill-based reuse create a major finishing threat.
uncertainties: Qualifying deaths include a brief post-hit window; exact timing is intentionally omitted.
Clone and resurrection-protected kills do not grant reuse or Noxian Might. Finishing a zombie-state target grants reuse without Noxian Might.
Leap movement varies with distance and terrain; the explanation does not imply unrestricted terrain crossing.

conflicts.resolution: Use the Wiki's champion-specific empowerment trigger rather than extending Riot's abbreviated wording to every enemy type.
Include large monsters in Q healing because Riot and the Wiki's detailed description agree.
Describe temporary reuse generally and explicitly distinguish the maximum-rank reset; retain special target exceptions in metadata.
conflicts.topic: R reuse scope and maximum-rank behavior

cooldown_candidates.reason: The pull controls whether Darius can force close combat.
Kill-based recasts and the maximum-rank reset change whether his finishing threat remains available.
Availability of the circular strike affects his access to blade damage and healing.
Killing a target can reduce the empowered attack's cooldown, with a jungle-plant exception.
